description.p: Lumi is an opinionated modern browser focused on productivity and privacy. With a clean, minimalistic user interface, it helps you focus on your work and get things done quickly.
Features that make it stand out:

ul.li: Clean, collapsible sidebar and horizontal topbar layouts
Command palette to quickly open a new tab, bookmark, or history
Supports streaming services via Widevine DRM

description.p: Add trackpad two-finger Back/Forward overscroll navigation with a Liquid Glass edge indicator, macOS 3-finger swipe and app-command support, early pinch-to-zoom limits, fixed sidebar Space-switching swipe alignment and full-sidebar gesture coverage, and ambient CSS/spring animations across browser chrome, Start Page, Omnibox, Side Panel, and media controls.

Add persistent collapsible card tab folders with color tints and inline rename, smart offline domain/duplicate Tidy cleanup with Undo toast, fluid count-aware pinned tab grids, streamlined 3-slot sidebar footer dock with Space dropdown and Workspace/Profile menu, sidebar status polish (unread dots, single-row update CTA, downloads dot, conditional MCP pill), media mini-player artwork-to-favicon fallback, and complete session recovery across update restarts.

Fix HTML5 video players sometimes remaining full-viewport inside the window after exiting OS fullscreen by verifying fullscreen exit across frames, queueing mid-animation macOS fullscreen exits, and re-checking on tab show/move, and stop sidebar address bar action buttons from jumping sideways on hover.

Fix YouTube player failing to initialize when Content Blocker cosmetic scriptlets collide in global scope (preventing Function.prototype.toString stack overflow and JSONPath redeclaration errors), and serialize multi-profile adblocker lifecycle and IPC registration.

Fix unentitled macOS passkey prompts hanging so sign-ins fall back cleanly, add Liquid Glass unread count badges on pinned tabs via W3C App Badging and title parsing, display pinned tabs in Horizontal Topbar mode, add a right-click layout switcher menu on empty Sidebar and Topbar chrome, and unify Sidebar Bottom Dock and Space Switcher button styling and single-row layout.

Open the Start Page (lumi://new-tab) or wake the most recently active restored tab instead of showing a blank screen on browser launch or empty spaces, add 5-minute background and window-focus auto-update checks with a Topbar Update pill, and reduce CPU, GPU, and RAM usage via background tab sleeping/throttling, Chromium memory-reclaim flags, and trimmed SQLite and Sharp caches.

Fix Browser Importer history diffing for entries older than 180 days or with missing timestamps across Perplexity Comet, Opera, Firefox, and all supported browsers, open Shift+Left-Click links in a new foreground tab, fix blank popup windows by providing PinnedTabs/BrowserAction/Extensions context in popup-ui, and keep CI release tags private until all OS artifacts finish uploading.

Fix macOS Liquid Glass Tinted, Clear, and Light Dock icon border artifacts in Assets.car, add diff-aware Browser Importer previews (Already imported vs. new deltas) and single-prompt Keychain caching, declutter the vertical sidebar address bar, and auto-fetch favicons for imported pinned tabs.

Add built-in per-profile OS Keychain-encrypted Password Manager (lumi://passwords) with macOS Touch ID protection, closed-Shadow-DOM in-page autofill and strong password generator, Save/Update prompts, zero-plaintext enforcement, Chrome/Firefox password decryption, active session migration (cookies, localStorage, and IndexedDB), 50,000-entry history import limit, and Firestore Shield keepalive fixes.

Fix macOS Browser Importer hiding privacy-blocked Chrome/Firefox profiles and misreporting Safari unreadability, and add one-click System Settings links, Locked badges, and automatic focus rescan across Settings and Onboarding.

Harden the local MCP server so JavaScript evaluation, DOM automation, content extraction, and screenshots are blocked on privileged lumi://, chrome-extension://, and file:// tabs while preserving navigation out of lumi://new-tab.

Fix Split View and Glance tab close teardown crash (EventEmitter already destroyed) and surviving pane layout restore, wait for split pane navigation in lumi_open_split_view, and improve MCP Live Agent Activity error summaries.

Add an opt-in Native Local MCP Server (Streamable HTTP + stdio bridge with tiered permissions, Bearer auth, profile scoping, and live activity log), upgrade the first-run Onboarding Studio with interactive Space and Layout previews plus spring animations across Omnibox, New Tab, and Side Panel, and add motion GIF previews to the README.

Add cross-platform Browser Importer in Settings and Onboarding supporting 37 browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Zen, Arc, Dia, Comet, Brave, Edge, Opera, Flow, and more) plus HTML bookmarks, and drastically speed up GitHub Actions CI checks and multi-OS builds.

Lumi Prism: Unified in-tab Settings (lumi://settings) with redesigned responsive wide workspace and side-by-side Space Editor, 5-phase performance & memory overhaul (lazy icon/bang bundles, faster cold start, SQLite history indexes, 30m default tab sleep & portal pool trimming, Adblocker binary cache, zero-polling push IPC), responsive sidebar dock, and faster CI packaging.

Upgrade Electron to v45.2.1+wvcus (Chromium 156) and core dependencies, fix Chrome Web Store preload packaging and install flow, fix sidebar popover window drag sticking, and fix the blank macOS application menu item.

Lumi Glow: Native Liquid Glass UI overhaul across Settings, Browser Chrome, Command Palette, Onboarding, and internal pages; Dock/Settings z-order restoration; Unified Site Control Center; Omnibox instant tools; Focus/Zen Mode, Workspace Snapshots, Persistent Split Side Panel, and Built-in Page Capture.
Improve macOS Full Disk Access registration and Reveal Lumi.app guidance for Safari Sync, harden draft-until-ready release publishing in CI, and refine updater 404 messaging.
Fix production startup circular initialization in pinned-tabs helpers so Lumi launches reliably across all platforms.

Split View & Glance Tab Groups, Reader Mode, Native Download Manager (lumi://downloads), Omnibox Pedals, SHA-512 macOS Self-Updater, Safari Connectivity & External Sync, Liquid Glass icon cleanup, and complete roadmap delivery.
Complete legacy Flow protocol eradication, window.lumi API exclusive namespace, zero-alias refactor, and AppStream metadata.
